responsibility: This module is the GCC target backend for the LatticeMico32 (LM32) architecture, covering the machine-dependent code generation, ABI rules, and OS personality glue needed to compile GCC RTL into LM32 assembly and linked binaries. Its core files split the backend into static target specification and ABI constants in lm32.h, executable target-hook logic in lm32.c/lm32.cc for calling conventions, frame layout, prologue/epilogue emission, address legitimacy, PIC and small-data handling, varargs, block moves, branch/compare expansion, operand printing, and cost modeling, and declarative instruction selection and scheduling in lm32.md with companion predicates and constraints files that define valid operand forms and encodable immediates for reload and recognizers. The module also defines LM32-specific -m options for optional hardware features such as multiply, divide, barrel shift, sign extension, and user instructions, and includes OS-specific headers like rtems.h and uclinux-elf.h that adapt the generic LM32 ELF port to particular runtime, preprocessor, startup, and linking conventions. Overall, this module is the architecture-specific layer that distinguishes LM32 code generation from neighboring GCC backends by combining instruction patterns, ABI policy, addressing rules, feature flags, and system integration for this processor family.
